subject: HarborOps onboarding — PO number assignment, spend cap, and line-item adjustments
messages:
From: Elena Rusu <elena@harborops.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HarborOps — vendor onboarding / PO and spend cap info

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — I’m Elena, HarborOps’ partnerships lead. We’re ready to complete Redwood’s vendor onboarding. I’ve attached our W-9 and a short onboarding form. A couple of questions to help us align our billing: 

- Can you confirm the provisional PO number or numbering convention you’ll use so we can reference it on invoices?
- Our account team mentioned a monthly spend cap during onboarding — can you share the threshold and whether it’s configurable?
- One of our invoices uses two consolidated line items (Platform Services and Implementation). Do you prefer split SKUs per Redwood chart of accounts or one combined line?

Attached: HarborOps_W-9.pdf

Best,
Elena Rusu
Partnerships — HarborOps
elena@harborops.com
+1 (415) 555-0187
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rusu <elena@harborops.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HarborOps — vendor onboarding / PO and spend cap info

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9. A few items on our side: 

- We can provisionally reserve a PO number while legal completes standard checks. That provisional will be in the PO-2026-07xx series; procurement will lock a final number once the onboarding form and tax docs are validated.
- The default onboarding spend cap is $50,000/month for new partners; that can be increased after the first quarter pending spend review and credit approval.
- We typically request split line items to match Redwood SKU codes (Platform, Integration, Support) to make cost-center tagging and downstream billing easier. If HarborOps prefers combined lines, we can map to two ledger codes on our end.

Can you return the completed onboarding_form_signed.pdf and a sample invoice with the line-item breakdown (if possible, as an XLSX)? I’ll loop in Connor from procurement to propose a provisional PO and route for finance review.

Thanks,
Sofia 
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Enablement — Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

Sofia,

Thanks 99999for the details. Attached: HarborOps_onboarding_form_signed.pdf and HarborOps_invoice_lines.xlsx.

Quick notes from our billing team (copied):
- Invoice A lists Platform Services as a single line at $32,000.
- Invoice B lists Implementation as two sub-lines (Project Kickoff and Data Migration) totalling $18,000.

We prefer combined lines on our invoices (keeps our internal accounting simpler), but happy to have Redwood map them to separate SKUs if thatacilitates your ledger. If you issue a provisional PO with the spend cap noted, we can begin delivery and submit invoices against that PO.

Subject: Re: HarborOps — vendor onboarding / PO and spend cap info

Elena, Sofia —

Thanks for the docs. We reviewed the attachments and propose the following provisional PO details to unblock delivery work: 

Provisional PO: PO-2026-0789 (final PO to be assigned once tax & legal sign-off complete)
Monthly onboarding spend cap: $50,000 (finance will monitor actuals and can approve increases after two billing cycles)

Two items for resolution before we finalize: 
1) Line mapping: Invoice A "Platform Services" will be split on our ledger into PLAT-CORE (Platform core runtime) and PLAT-OPS (ops support) for accounting. Can HarborOps accept Redwood mapping (we will not change invoice total)?
2) Implementation line: HarborOps has Implementation as two sub-lines; our procurement system requires unique line-item codes for each purchasable unit. We need the vendor to either provide SKU codes for the two sub-lines or sign off on Redwood-assigned codes (we can send a short mapping table).

If you accept the provisional PO and the two mapping items above, we’ll route to finance for the formal PO PDF. I9m putting Kim on copy for any spend-cap or billing concerns. Also linking the onboarding ticket: https://hubspot.company/contacts/12345 (will update with PO number).

Connor Obrien
Senior Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Connor, Sofia —

Approved to issue: PO-2026-0789 (draft attached). Finance confirms the $50,000/month onboarding ceiling. Two small corrections to the line-item structure before we send the final PO PDF to HarborOps billing: 

- Line 2 (Implementation 99999) should be split into: 2A: IMP-KICKOFF (Data collection & kickoff) and 2B: IMP-MIGRATE (Data migration). Please set quantities 1 and 1 respectively and assign Redwood ledger codes IMP-100 / IMP-200.
- Platform Services line should have the unit code SERV-STD rather than the generic "Service" to align with cost center reports.

Sofia/Connor: once HarborOps confirms acceptance of the mapping (or returns vendor SKU codes), procurement will finalize the PO and send the signed PDF to billing@harborops.com.

Attachments: PO-2026-0789-draft.pdf

Marcus Lin
